extracted.intended_audience: Pennsylvania residents, businesses, charities, professional license applicants and renewers, notaries, voters, and other users seeking Department of State services or information
extracted.subtask_description: Homepage/landing page for the Pennsylvania Department of State that summarizes and links to the department's programs and services (business registration, charities, professional licensing, voting & elections, notaries, document certification, state athletics, news and resources). It is an entry point to guidance, forms, contact info, and news rather than a procedural rubric.
